press_references.value: LatchBio Releases a 25 Million Cell Human Spatial Transcriptomics Atlas and Agentic Spatial Curation Tools

product_launches.description: LatchBio launched a public 25 million cell human spatial transcriptomics atlas spanning 45 tissues, 63 diseases, and 11 spatial technologies, with an online portal for access and analysis and new agentic curation tools to streamline dataset annotation.

press_references.value: Miraomics, Pythia Biosciences and LatchBio Release a 30 Million Cell Atlas and an Agentric AI Framework for Molecular Data Curation

product_launches.description: LatchBio, in collaboration with Miraomics and Pythia Biosciences, launched a 30 million cell atlas covering 150 diseases, 200 tissues, and 27 technologies, providing a comprehensive resource for molecular data analysis. Additionally, LatchBio released an agentric AI curation framework to automate and improve molecular data cleaning and annotation.

overview_description.description: LatchBio develops a data infrastructure intended to build and disseminate the open-source infrastructure of the biocomputing revolution. Founded in 2021 by Alfredo Andere, Kyle Giffin, and Kenny Workman, the company creates open-source machine learning and cloud infrastructure for the next generation of therapeutic discovery, thereby enabling biotech companies to find therapies faster and save on engineering.

about_short_description.short_description: LatchBio is a biotech research company that provides code-free platform for the biocomputing revolution.

product.name: LatchBio Platform
product.description: A cloud-based, code-free biocomputing platform that connects biological data, metadata, workflows, scalable compute, visualizations, and collaborative analysis in one workspace.

product.name: Latch Agents
product.description: AI agents for analyzing biological datasets and assisting with code, visualizations, workflows, and scientific interpretation in a cloud-based research environment.

product.name: Agent.bio
product.description: An interactive deployment environment where users can apply AI agents to biological data analysis through a browser-based sandbox.

identifier.value: White-Labeled Analysis Portals for Solution Providers

product.name: White-Labeled Analysis Portals for Solution Providers
product.description: Customizable analysis portals that let sequencing, assay, kit, and instrument providers deliver branded data-processing and reporting experiences to their customers.

product.name: Latch Biosecurity
product.description: Biosecurity evaluation and risk-assessment services for frontier AI and biology systems, including benchmarks, audits, red-teaming, and automated identity checks.

product.name: ATAC-seq Analysis Solution
product.description: An end-to-end cloud workflow for processing ATAC-seq data, from sequencing reads and quality control through peak calling, annotation, visualization, and interpretation.
